title: Acceptance test.
officialText:
Acceptance testing shall be done in accordance with the requirements of the New York City Fire Code and NFPA
20. Refurbished or repaired fire pumps shall be tested in accordance with the New York City Fire Code and NFPA 20.
SECTION BC 914
EMERGENCY RESPONDER SAFETY FEATURES
